pararev.evaluation: New outputs need blind human judgments and a technical-meaning preservation gate. Author revisions are comparison context, not factual or exact-match gold.
pararev.allowed_claim: A scoped adapted paragraph-revision task; not an official score or a systems-venue acceptance result.

parareval.evaluation: Local categorical agreement on fixed A/B outputs, retaining annotator disagreements. It does not score a newly generated revision.
parareval.allowed_claim: A judge-calibration observation, not skill writing quality, scientific factuality, or validated judge reliability after one example.
